description: Moves an existing booking (appointmentId from get_bookings) to a new time and emails the customer about the change. Before calling, tell the user which booking (customer, current time) is moving to which new time, and get their explicit yes; then pass confirm: true. Executes as soon as it is called with confirm: true.

confirm.description: true only after the user has explicitly confirmed this specific change in the conversation

timezone.description: IANA timezone; defaults to the booking’s existing timezone

name: reschedule_booking

_environment.description: The Nexwin country and environment that supplied the result

title: Reschedule a booking
